died.name: Sejong the Great
died.cause: Korea would later be invaded and pillaged by the Japanese, and later, subjugated by the Manchus, who the Koreans considered 'barbarians'
died.last_words: Although dealing with the Japanese and the barbarians is not something that should be taken lightly, I fear that as peace is ingrained in you, the days growing longer, all matters might be done lazily and slowly, so you should always be careful and watch out every day, so you do not give in to negligence.

died.name: William Hunter
died.last_words: If I had strength to hold a pen, I would write down how easy and pleasant a thing it is to die.

died.name: Lovisa
died.last_words: I am positioned between Heaven and Earth and feel like I am surrounded by nothing but light. Kiss me one last time! If I have failed in my duties toward you, then forgive me.

died.name: James W. Rodgers
died.last_words: I done told you my last request ... a bulletproof vest.

born.name: Sir William Erskine, 2nd Baronet
born.cause: after jumping from a window in Lisbon, Portugal
born.last_words: Now, why did I do that?

born.name: Paul Verlaine
born.cause: who spent much of his later life in poverty
born.last_words: Don't sole the dead man's shoes yet!

born.name: Vincent van Gogh
born.cause: to his brother sometime before dying of (presumably) a self-inflicted gunshot wound
